name: The gear opens the Settings drawer on the right with the API key and the generator values
eval: localStorage.removeItem('addturngpx.generator'); window.__S = { wait: (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)), drawer: settingsDrawer, gear: document.getElementById('btn-settings'), angle: document.getElementById('set-angle'), spacing: document.getElementById('set-spacing') }; saveJSON(GH_KEY_KEY, 'k1'); __S.gear.click(); await __S.wait(250); const r = __S.drawer.getBoundingClientRect(); const out = { open: __S.drawer.open, right: Math.round(r.right) === innerWidth, width: Math.round(r.width), height: Math.round(r.height) === innerHeight, key: document.getElementById('key-input').value, remove: !document.getElementById('key-remove').hidden, angle: __S.angle.value, spacing: __S.spacing.value }; document.getElementById('settings-close').click(); return { ...out, closed: !__S.drawer.open }

name: Clicking outside the drawer closes it, clicking inside does not
eval: __S.gear.click(); document.querySelector('#settings-drawer h2').click(); const inside = __S.drawer.open; __S.drawer.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', { bubbles: true })); return { inside, outside: !__S.drawer.open }

name: There is no generator card; the planning card has no settings of its own either
eval: __setTiles({ of: 'blocked', osmf: 'blocked' }); __overpass.mode = 'fixture'; await openFromUrl(location.origin + '/samples/Vracov%205km.gpx'); document.getElementById('btn-generate').click(); for (let i = 0; i < 100 && genBusy; i++) await __S.wait(50); return { card: !!document.getElementById('gen-card'), inputs: document.querySelectorAll('#panel-body input[type=number]').length, turns: wptItems.filter(w => !w.fixed).length > 3 }

name: A changed value applies to the next Generate turns; Esc in the drawer closes only the drawer
eval: const base = wptItems.filter(w => !w.fixed).length; __S.gear.click(); window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Escape' })); __S.angle.value = 45; __S.angle.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); const r = { file: !!gpx, saved: loadJSON('addturngpx.generator', {}) }; __S.drawer.close(); document.getElementById('btn-generate').click(); await __S.wait(20); for (let i = 0; i < 100 && genBusy; i++) await __S.wait(50); return { ...r, fewer: wptItems.filter(w => !w.fixed).length < base }

name: A value typed before closing counts; limits are enforced
eval: __S.gear.click(); __S.spacing.value = 9999; __S.drawer.close(); await __S.wait(20); const r = { spacing: genSettings().spacing, shown: __S.spacing.value }; localStorage.removeItem('addturngpx.generator'); return r

name: Turns in advance: 0 m by default, 0 can be set again, an empty field keeps the value, limit 100 m
eval: const lead = document.getElementById('set-lead'); const set = (v) => { lead.value = v; lead.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); return loadJSON('addturngpx.generator', {}).lead; }; __S.gear.click(); const first = lead.value; const r = { first, set25: set('25'), set0: set('0'), empty: set(''), shown: lead.value, max: set('500') }; __S.drawer.close(); localStorage.removeItem('addturngpx.generator'); return r

name: Phone: the drawer fills the screen and the toolbar with the gear still fits
eval: const bar = document.getElementById('topbar'); const gear = document.getElementById('btn-settings').getBoundingClientRect(); const fits = bar.scrollWidth <= bar.clientWidth && gear.right <= innerWidth && gear.width > 0; document.getElementById('btn-settings').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); const r = settingsDrawer.getBoundingClientRect(); const out = { fits, full: Math.round(r.width) === innerWidth && Math.round(r.left) === 0 }; settingsDrawer.close(); return out
